value.rationale: The onset of oscillatory power-spectrum dominance is a measurable signature in finite molecular Markov networks; a zero-frequency curvature test can miss its onset. The sharp partition identifies when the dominant frequency emerges continuously, degenerately, or by a finite jump, and determines exactly the missing rate window. The boundary is dimensionless, does not rely on thermodynamic limits, and supplies a physically interpretable diagnostic rather than a change of normalization or a routine fixed-parameter table. The novelty is the global bifurcation classification of a motivated explicit model, not the elementary algebra alone.
